info.name: Fitnix Member App API (v1)
info.description:
Member mobile app API.

**Flow:** Check version → Send OTP → Verify OTP → Get gym branding.

Run the requests in order. The test scripts save values into collection variables automatically:
- **Send OTP** stores `otp` (from `debug_otp`, only returned when `OTP_EXPOSE_IN_RESPONSE=true` in a non-production environment) and `gym_id`.
- **Verify OTP** stores `token` and `gym_id`.

All authenticated requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

**Response format**
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "code": "ERROR_CODE", "data"?: { ... }, "errors"?: { ... } }`

**Error codes:** VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHENTICATED, NO_GYM_CONNECTED, MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, MULTIPLE_GYMS, OTP_TOO_MANY, OTP_TOO_MANY, OTP_NOT_FOUND, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_INVALID, OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED, MEMBER_INACTIVE, GYM_NOT_FOUND, GYM_INACTIVE, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT, NOT_CHECKED_IN, NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP, SELF_CHECKIN_DISABLED, PLAN_NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, NOT_FOUND.

exec: if (d.force_update) { console.log('FORCE UPDATE → ' + d.store_url); } else if (d.update_available) { console.log('Optional update available: ' + d.latest_version); }

request.description:
Call on app launch.

- `force_update: true` → installed version is below the minimum supported version. Block the app and send the user to `store_url`.
- `update_available: true` → a newer version exists. Show an optional update prompt.
- `maintenance.enabled: true` → show `maintenance.message`.

Versions are managed by the Super Admin in **Platform → Settings → Member mobile app**.

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP by SMS to a registered, active member.

**Body**
- `phone` (required) — any format: `9876543210`, `+91 98765 43210`, `09876543210`.
- `gym_id` (optional) — required only when the number belongs to members of more than one gym (see the *Send OTP — choose gym* request).

**Rules:** OTP valid 5 minutes · resend allowed after 30 s · max 5 OTPs per number per hour.

`debug_otp` is included only when `OTP_EXPOSE_IN_RESPONSE=true` and the app is not in production.

**Not connected to any gym (fallback):** if the number is not an active member of any active gym (never registered, deactivated or removed by their gym, or their gym is suspended), the API returns `404 NO_GYM_CONNECTED` with `data.callback_requested: true`. The number is saved as a **lead** in Super Admin → App Leads and a support executive calls back with nearby gyms.

Optional lead fields (used only in that case): `name`, `city`, `latitude` + `longitude` (for gyms near the user), `app_platform`, `app_version`.

**Waiting for approval:** a number that signed up through *5. Sign up* and is not approved yet gets `403 MEMBER_PENDING_APPROVAL` (with `data.gym_id`, `data.gym_name`) and is not saved as a lead.

response.name: OTP sent
Not connected to any gym (saved as lead)
Number registered at multiple gyms
Resend too soon

request.description: Use after a `409 MULTIPLE_GYMS` response: set `gym_id` to the gym the member picked, then send again. Pass the same `gym_id` to *Verify OTP*.

Verifies the OTP and returns a Sanctum **Bearer token** plus the member's `gym_id` (use it for the branding API).

**Body**
- `phone` (required)
- `otp` (required, 6 digits)
- `gym_id` (optional — only if it was needed for Send OTP)
- `device_name` (optional — shown when listing/revoking tokens)

An OTP can be used once. After 5 wrong attempts it is locked; request a new one.

request.description:
Branding for the member's gym (`gym_id` from Verify OTP). Requires the Bearer token.

Returns logo, banner, colours, tagline, description, contact, social links, opening hours, facilities and photos.

**Errors**
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/invalid/revoked token
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — `gym_id` is not the member's gym
- `403 GYM_INACTIVE` — gym is suspended/deactivated (`data.gym_status`)
- `403 MEMBER_INACTIVE` — the gym deactivated this member (token is revoked)
- `404 GYM_NOT_FOUND` — no such gym

Expiring soon = 7 days or fewer left (config gymai.membership_expiring_soon_days). history: all memberships, newest first, each with status.

Data for the home-screen streak card. Requires the Bearer token and an active gym.

- `current_streak` — visit days in the live streak ("12 DAY STREAK")
- `visits_this_month` — "18 visits this month"
- `week` — Mon→Sun dots. `status`: `attended` (filled ✓), `missed` (empty), `closed` (gym closed that day), `today` (dashed — not checked in yet), `upcoming`
- `at_risk` — true when skipping today would break the streak (show a nudge)
- `next_milestone` — e.g. 2 more visit days to reach 14
- `rules.grace_days` — rest days allowed between visits (set by the gym)

Streaks update automatically on every check-in.

request.description:
Member checks themselves in (the CHECK IN NOW button). Returns the attendance and the refreshed streak so the card updates immediately.

**Errors:** `409 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN` · `403 NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP` · `403 SELF_CHECKIN_DISABLED` (gym turned it off) · `403 GYM_INACTIVE`.

Optional JSON body `{"code": "<text read from the gym's check-in QR>"}`. Not required yet, but a wrong or expired code fails with 422 `INVALID_CHECKIN_CODE`. Send the scanned text as it is. Gyms can use a printed QR or a screen QR that changes every 30 seconds.

response.name: Checked in

item.name: Check in by scanning gym QR

request.description: Send the exact scanned text. Accepts the gym's join link, registration link or check-in QR (http/https, trailing slash and query string are fine). 200: check-in status + attendance + streak + source 'qr'. Errors: 422 INVALID_QR, 403 WRONG_GYM, 422 QR_EXPIRED (gym uses the live screen QR), 403 NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP, 403 SELF_CHECKIN_DISABLED, 403 QR_CHECKIN_DISABLED, 403 GYM_CLOSED, 409 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN (data = current status). 10 requests/minute.

Ends today's visit.

**Errors:** `409 NOT_CHECKED_IN` · `409 ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT`.

Optional JSON body `{"code": "<text read from the gym's check-in QR>"}`. Not required yet, but a wrong or expired code fails with 422 `INVALID_CHECKIN_CODE`. Send the scanned text as it is. Gyms can use a printed QR or a screen QR that changes every 30 seconds.

item.name: Push notifications
item.description:
Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1. The app calls POST /me/devices on every launch (and on token refresh); DELETE /me/devices (or /auth/logout with device_token) on logout.

Every push: notification {title, body, image?}, android.notification.channel_id = general | reminders | membership | announcements, data (all strings) = { notification_id (= member_notifications.id), type, screen, channel, gym_id, image_url?, ...ids }; with a picture also notification.image and android.notification.image. screen: home, profile, membership, payments, progress, weight, plans, workout, diet, streak, checkin, gym.

Types: announcement, membership_expiring, membership_expired, payment_received, balance_due, plan_assigned, goal_achieved, weigh_in_due, workout_reminder, streak_at_risk, test.

request.description: Body: token (max 512), platform android|ios, device_name?, app_version?. Response: { success, message: "Device registered.", data: { registered: true } }. A token used by another member moves to this member.
Removes the token only if it belongs to the current member. Always 200 "Device removed."

Newest first, with unread_count and pagination (?page=, ?per_page=20, ?unread=1). Each item: { id, type, title, body (full text), image_url (or null), screen, data { screen, channel, ... }, is_read, read_at, created_at } - dates ISO 8601 with +05:30. Open the detail page from a push with data.notification_id.
Only the member's own notifications (404 otherwise). Sets read_at once; returns unread_count.
reminders / announcements toggles. Membership, payment and program updates are always on.

item.name: 5. Sign up (new members)
item.description:
For people who are not members yet: verify phone → pick a city → pick a gym in that city → send details. The member starts **pending** until the gym approves.

Run the requests in order; each one saves the variables the next one needs (`city_id`, `gym_id`, `otp`, `registration_token`).

Members who join with the QR code at the gym's desk don't use these endpoints: that form already knows the gym and creates an active member.

request.description:
Step 1 of sign-up for people who are not members yet. Returns the cities Fitnix is live in (managed by the Super Admin), A to Z.

No login needed. `gyms_count` counts only gyms that are currently active.

response.name: Cities

request.description: Areas of the city that have gyms, with gyms_count each, plus the city's total gyms_count. Show this after the city: an "All areas" choice plus each locality. An empty list means the city has no localities yet: skip straight to the gym list.

query.description: Optional. Part of the gym name, for type-ahead.
Optional: only gyms in this locality (id from List localities)

request.description:
Step 2: gyms in the chosen city, filtered as the user types (`search`, optional). Up to 30 results, A to Z. Only active gyms are returned.

`404 CITY_NOT_FOUND` if the city is not live.

Optional locality_id filters to one locality. Each gym now also has `locality` (name or null). Each gym also has `public_url` (its public profile page: open it in the phone's browser, e.g. a "View gym" button) and `directions_url` (the gym's Google Maps link, or a Maps search for its address).

City not live

request.description:
Step 3: send an OTP to verify a **new** user's phone. Works for any number, member or not.

Same rules as login OTPs: valid 5 minutes, resend after 30 s, max 5 per number per hour (`OTP_TOO_MANY`, `OTP_TOO_MANY`).

`debug_otp` is included only when `OTP_EXPOSE_IN_RESPONSE=true` and the app is not in production.

response.name: OTP sent

request.description:
Step 4: check the OTP. Returns a `registration_token` that proves the phone was verified. It is valid for 30 minutes and can be used **once**.

Errors: `OTP_INVALID` (with `attempts_left`), `OTP_EXPIRED`, `OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`, `OTP_NOT_FOUND`.

response.name: Verified

request.description:
Step 5: create the member at the chosen gym. Required: `registration_token`, `city_id`, `gym_id`, `name`. Everything else is optional.

The member is created as **pending** and gets **no login token**. The gym approves the registration in its panel; after that the user logs in normally with *2. Auth → Send OTP / Verify OTP*. Until then, *Send OTP* answers `403 MEMBER_PENDING_APPROVAL` with `data.gym_name`.

Errors: `REGISTRATION_TOKEN_INVALID` (expired or already used: verify the phone again), `CITY_NOT_FOUND`, `GYM_NOT_FOUND` (gym not active or not in that city), `ALREADY_REGISTERED` (409, the number is already a member of that gym).

item.name: 6. AI coach & body progress
item.description: Measurements, progress photos and AI reports. AI is controlled by the Super Admin and the gym admin; members need to accept the consent text once.

request.description: Show on the AI coach screen. available (gym switched AI on and the member is eligible), has_consented, consent_text (show it with an Accept checkbox before first use), credits {limit, used, remaining, resets_on}, features {progress, photo_comparison: {available, credits}}, disclaimer (show under every report).

item.name: Accept / withdraw AI consent (withdrawing deletes all AI reports and progress photos)

request.description: accepted: true | false. Returns the same data as AI coach status.

type: progress (uses weight, goal, measurements, attendance, streak and program adherence) or photo_comparison (also before_photo_id and after_photo_id from GET /me/progress-photos; always compared older → newer).

202 Accepted with data.report {id, type, status pending|completed|failed, content (Markdown), credits, created_at, completed_at, disclaimer} and data.credits. Generation runs in the background: poll GET /me/ai/reports/{id} until status is completed or failed, or wait for the push (type ai_report_ready, data.report_id). Failed reports use no credits.

Errors (code): AI_DISABLED (platform switched off), AI_NOT_AVAILABLE (gym has not switched AI on), AI_FEATURE_DISABLED (photo comparison off for this gym), AI_NOT_ELIGIBLE (no valid membership, or not on an AI plan / not picked by the gym), AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED (call POST /me/ai/consent first), AI_LIMIT_REACHED (429, member used this month's credits), AI_GYM_LIMIT_REACHED (429, gym's monthly pool used). Error responses carry data.credits.

- `weight`: first_kg, latest_kg, change_kg, history [{date, value}] (null / empty without weigh-ins).
- `measurements`: one entry per recorded field with first, latest, change (null with a single entry) and history.
- `photos`: first (`before`) and latest (`after`) photo of each pose that has at least two. `image_url` needs the same bearer token.
- `latest_comparison`: the newest finished AI photo comparison, or null.
